Support IoT Service Monitoring Monitor next-generation IoT service performance using tools such as Grafana, DataDog , and Nagios. Track service availability and identify performance degradation in real time. Coordinate with operations personnel to support timely issue identification and response. Provide Network Operations Support Perform basic network testing and troubleshooting across network devices and connectivity paths. Assist in resolving connectivity issues involving serial server appliances, switches, routers, and related infrastructure. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support operational continuity and service reliability. Ensure Operational Continuity Partner with Network Control Center colleagues and Satellite Engineering teams to facilitate effective shift handoffs. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime.
